title: feat(app-shell, plugin-approvals): edit a record and its line tables in one save; a locked record locks its lines
body:
Fixes #35599
Part of #35590

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 有明细表的记录页：点「编辑」后主记录字段和明细行一起可改，点一次保存就一起写入；单字段就地编辑在所有记录页都保留，只保存主记录；两种编辑同一时间只开一种。
- 属于「记录详情页重做」专题，替业务用户解决主记录和明细要分开改、分开存的问题；审批锁定中的记录，其明细行也一起锁住。
- 保存被拒时什么都不写入，改动留在屏幕上，原因标在对应字段或明细行下；带着未保存的就地修改点「编辑」会先问是否放弃；出问题可直接撤回本次合并。
- 无

## What changes

**Server, ruling A (settled, 「一起锁」).** `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` binds a second lock hook, `bindDetailRowLockHook`, beside the existing record lock. While a master record is held by a locking pending approval (`lockRecord` not false), writes to its `master_detail` child rows are refused `RECORD_LOCKED` (409), with the same user sentence the record lock uses, naming the master by its object label:

- `beforeInsert` reads the new row's FK; `beforeUpdate` and `beforeDelete` read `previous[fk]`. An update that moves the FK also checks the new master, so a reparent is checked at both ends.
- Predicate (multi-row) writes are judged per row: the engine dispatches before-hooks per row with `previous` bound (ADR-0058 Addendum II), so any touched row under a locked master refuses the whole write.
- When no row can be resolved (no `previous`, and the id read finds nothing), the write fails closed: it is refused if the master object has any locking request the writer's run does not own.
- The existing exemptions carry over: `session.isSystem`, and the flow run that opened the approval (`provenance.flowRunId === request.flow_run_id`).
- Lookup children are not locked, because ruling A names master-detail rows. `sys_approval*` masters are skipped.
- `recordHeldByLockingApproval` now shares one private helper, `lockingRequestsForRecords`, with the new hook. Its own behaviour is unchanged.

**Client, edit state (items 1-4, 6).** On a record page that draws master-detail body tables, Edit now opens the page's edit state instead of the record form.

- The record-level inline session enters, so the fields become inputs.
- The page keeps its `record:related_list` nodes. While the edit state is open (and one batch can carry the tables), its controller provides `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s new `RecordBodyTableEditorSlotContext`: the edited relationship ids and a render function. The `record:related_list` renderer reads it first, and a list whose `objectName.relationshipField` id is in the set draws the host's editor in its place instead of the read-only list. No node type is registered for the editor. The editor is `@object-ui/plugin-form`'s new `RecordBodyTableEditor`, built from `MasterDetailForm`'s pieces: the `LineItemsField` grid, `deriveDetail` columns, `applyColumnPermissions`, and the `relatedNew` / `relatedRowDelete` add and remove rules.
- The header's Edit slot holds Cancel and Save, pushed as two system action items through the existing header item list. The header layout is unchanged.
- Save builds ONE `POST /api/v1/batch` with `buildRecordEditBatch`: op 0 is the record update (only the edited fields), followed by each table's `buildMasterDetailEditBatch` diff (create / dirty-fields update / delete). It is the same construction `MasterDetailForm` and `LineItemsPanel` persist through, reused without a fork, and `MasterDetailForm.tsx` is untouched.
- On a refusal nothing lands, because the batch is one transaction. `attributeRecordEditRefusal` places each reason the server names on the record field, or on the line whose write carried that field, or on the table when several lines carry it. A reason with no field, such as a lock, becomes the summary line.
- Cancel discards the record draft and the lines. The editors unmount and re-read their rows the next time Edit is pressed.
- Unsaved edits register with the shell's existing leave guard (`useRegisterUnsavedEdits`, `form.unsavedChanges`).
- The drawer renders the same `RecordDetailView`, so it gets the same edit state.

**Ruling B (settled: 「全部保留」).** Both edit modes stay, on every object, including objects with master-detail body tables. The provisional `canEdit` term that turned inline edit off on such pages is gone.

- Per-field inline edit (pencil, double-click) saves the record alone through the save bar: one `update`, no batch.
- Edit, then Save, saves the record and its body rows in one atomic batch (below).
- Only one mode runs at a time:
  - (a) In the edit state no inline edit is offered. The edit state occupies the record's single inline session, so every field is already an input and no pencil is drawn, and the save bar is not mounted while the edit state is on. So no separate `canEdit` term is needed for this. Adding `!recordEditState` to the conjunction would in fact break the edit state: the controller enters the record-level inline session, and the provider refuses `enter()` when `canEdit` is false.
  - (b) Pressing Edit while an inline session holds unsaved changes asks first, in an `AlertDialog` (the components primitive, not `window.confirm`): Keep editing leaves the inline draft in place, Discard drops it and enters the edit state over the stored values. An inline session with no changes is ended and the edit state opens without a question.
- On a page with body tables, Edit stays pressable during an inline session so that question can be asked. Every other page keeps greying Edit during an inline session, as before. Whether the page qualifies is state set during render, so the header's flag never lags a render.

**Item 5 choice: option 2, UI-only.** `POST /api/v1/batch` is a bulk surface, gated on `bulk ∧ child` for every object it writes. `bodyTablesSaveTogether` reads that gate from the objects' `enable` blocks the page already holds, through the spec's own `canServeApiOperation`. When the record lacks `bulk ∧ update`, or any table's child lacks `bulk ∧ create/update/delete`, the edit state still opens: the tables stay read-only with a notice saying why, and the record's own fields save through the plain update the inline session always used. Option 1 (auto-allow the batch path) would change `batch-routes.ts` or the enable rules, which is a REST contract change (Clause-② yes). Option 2 offers no edit the server would refuse and changes no contract.

**Client half of ruling A.** While `approvalLocked`, the page passes `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` a `serve` wrapper through the bridge's existing `serve` prop (`withDetailWritesWithheld`). The wrapper strips `onCreate`, `onEdit` and `onDelete` for master-detail children only. `RelatedList.tsx` and the bridge are not edited. The edit state never opens on a locked record, because the header draws no Edit there (objectstack#35593).

## Tests

<details><summary>Server: ruling A through the real engine (plugin-approvals)</summary>

`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/detail-row-lock.integration.test.ts` uses a real `ObjectQL` with the better-sqlite3 in-memory driver and the real hook:

- insert, update and delete under a locked master are refused, each with a free-master CONTROL;
- reparent into and out of a locked master is refused;
- predicate update and delete (`multi: true`) are refused;
- inside one transaction a refused row rolls the whole transaction back (the batch route's shape);
- CONTROLs that still write: a system write, the opening run (a stranger run is refused), a `lockRecord: false` node, and a lookup child.

Each refusal asserts `code` `RECORD_LOCKED`, `statusCode` 409 and the userMessage sentence.

Readings:

- `detail-row-lock.integration.test.ts` on the merged tree `d0bdc9da`, under the verify lock: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 10 passed (10)`. No `plugin-approvals` file changed after that commit; the head is `9cb0d100`.
- The whole `plugin-approvals` suite before the resume, on the branch at that time: `Test Files 125 passed (125)`, `Tests 1780 passed (1780)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals typecheck` exit 0 on `d0bdc9da`. That includes `check:test-typecheck`.

</details>

<details><summary>Server guard ablation (one-off, not committed)</summary>

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/lifecycle-hooks.ts`:

- The anchor `const edges = masterEdgesOf(engine, object);` was replaced by an empty edge list (anchor count 1 to 0, blob `def2d354757a` to `589ab177c306`).
- The suite imports the hook from source, so no build leg was needed.
- Result: `Tests 7 failed | 3 passed (10)`. Every refusal cell and the opening-run cell turned red. The three that stayed green are the controls that write anyway (system write, `lockRecord: false`, lookup child).
- Restored: blob == HEAD (`def2d354757a`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Client: the record page's edit state (app-shell harness, plugin-form, app-shell helpers)</summary>

`RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx` block `RecordDetailView.recordEditState-35599` renders the real record page at 1440 px on the app route:

- ruling B 「全部保留」: on a page with body tables the Summary pencil opens inline edit with the tables untouched, and the save bar's Save sends one `update` of the record alone and no batch. Edit then opens the edit state, not the record form; there no pencil and no save bar are drawn, and the header shows Save and Cancel instead of Edit;
- one mode at a time: with an unsaved inline change, Edit stays pressable and opens the discard dialog (the page's own, `window.confirm` never called). Keep editing keeps the draft and opens no edit state; Discard opens the edit state over the stored value, with no write;
- CONTROL: an inline session with no changes is ended and Edit enters the edit state with no dialog;
- one Save calls `batchTransaction` ONCE, and never `update`, `create` or `delete`, with op 0 `{object: quote, action: update, id, data: {summary}}` plus line create, line update (dirty field only), line delete and task update. That covers two body tables in one batch;
- a refused batch (`fields: [{field: product}]`) keeps every edit (the field input, the edited quantity, the new line) and draws the reason under the line table on the new line (`data-body-table-row-error="1"`). Cancel then leaves the edit state with no second write, and re-entering shows the stored values;
- item 5: a child without `bulk` keeps its table read-only with the notice, and the record saves through one `update` with no batch;
- ruling A, client half: a locked record's two body tables draw no New, while the same page unlocked draws both (CONTROL).

`RecordBodyTableEditor.recordEditBatch-35599.test.ts` covers batch construction and owner tracing (a blank ghost line emits no op, a removed line is drawn nowhere) and refusal placement (on the record field, on a line, on the table, and as the summary). `recordEditState.helpers-35599.test.ts` covers the item-5 decision across `bulk` combinations, and the detail-only strip, with a lookup CONTROL.

On the head `9cb0d100`, with `--maxWorkers=1 --pool=forks` under the verify lock, these five files gave `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 141 passed (141)`:

- `RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx`, all 70 tests, the seven `recordEditState-35599` cells among them;
- `recordEditState.helpers-35599.test.ts`;
- `RecordBodyTableEditor.recordEditBatch-35599.test.ts`;
- `scripts/__tests__/check-side-effects-array.test.ts`;
- `scripts/__tests__/known-schema-types-derivation-5115.test.ts`.

On the merged tree `d0bdc9da`, the three edit-state files plus `packages/i18n/` gave `Test Files 108 passed (108)`, `Tests 2039 passed | 13 skipped (2052)`. That includes the zh-Hant generated-catalogue pin.

`type-check` exit 0 for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/cli` on `9cb0d100`, and for `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` on `d0bdc9da`.

Two one-off mutations, each restored with blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`:

- `serve={approvalLocked` → `serve={false`: the ruling-A client cell turned red (`expected 2 to be +0`).
- Deleting the `&& !inlineEditOffForBodyTables` term (provisional B, now retired): that cell turned red (`expected 1 to be +0`).
- Ruling B 「全部保留」: `setConfirmDiscard(true)` swapped for `enterNow()` in the controller's `requestEnter`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0): the one-mode cell turned red (`Tests 1 failed | 6 passed`), and the restore was proved by blob == HEAD (`b0b0e192465c`) with an empty `git diff HEAD`.

</details>

Retired or migrated tests: the two `swapBodyTablesForEditors` cases in `recordEditState.helpers-35599.test.ts` are retired with the helper (see "Fixes after 9cb0d100"); `record-related-list.editorSlot-35599.test.tsx` pins the slot instead. The provisional ruling-B cell (`a page drawing body tables offers no per-field inline edit; a page with none keeps it (CONTROL)`) is retired, and the `children: false` fixture option it alone used goes with it. Its replacement is the three ruling-B cells above, in the same block. Nothing else existing was rewritten.

## Acceptance notes

- **Files outside the claim's surface, each needed by this diff:**
  - `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`: `check:system-context-census` requires a keyed row for the new hook's `isSystem` exemption. `bindDetailRowLockHook` joins row 41 beside `bindApprovalLockHook`, and the generated register was rewritten with `--write`.
  - `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-related-list.tsx` and `relatedListCompact.ts`: the editor slot (see "Fixes after 9cb0d100"). The original dispatch fenced `record-related-list.tsx` while #35601 is in flight; the follow-up fix order named that block file as the place for the slot check. The change is one import and one new wrapper component in front of the bound block. `RelatedList.tsx` is not edited.
  - `zh-Hant.ts`: regenerated from zh-Hans (`gen:zh-hant`).
  - `ui/packages/plugin-form` and `ui/packages/i18n`: for the reuse and the strings described above.
- **The erasure ratchet stays flat.** The new previous-row read and the two test reads carry `satisfies EngineQueryOptions`, so `lifecycle-hooks.ts` stays at its ceiling of 4 and the test surface does not grow.
- **The record-page eligibility is written during render.** `setRecordEditEligible` is called during render, not from an effect, because that point is below the view's early returns, where no hook may run. React re-renders before it commits, and the call does nothing once the value agrees.
- **Client gate (ruling A):** done through the bridge's existing `serve` prop. `RelatedList.tsx` and the bridge are not edited.
- **Write-path coverage (A3):** reported to the seat.

## Fixes after 9cb0d100

Two CI reds at `9cb0d100` came from registering the body-table editor as a component type, `record:body_table_editor`: `registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859` read 309 registered namespaced keys refused at `type` against its falling pin of 308, and `exclusion-reason-truthfulness` found the registration file was not imported there.

- `216a0464` enters the edit state's two saves in the write census (`affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx`): the record-alone `update` mapped to `recordEdit`, and the batch mapped to `recordEdit`, `relatedNew`, `relatedRowDelete` and `editFormFields`.
- `59d1dbd8` stops making the editor a registered type. `swapBodyTablesForEditors` and `BODY_TABLE_EDITOR_TYPE` are removed, and the page keeps its `record:related_list` nodes. `@object-ui/plugin-detail` exports `RecordBodyTableEditorSlotContext` beside `RecordBodyTablesContext`, and `RecordEditStateController` provides it with the edited ids and a render function for `RecordBodyTableEditor`. The `record:related_list` renderer checks it before either binding. `record-body-table-editor-renderer.tsx`, its barrel import and both `sideEffects` entries are removed, and `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES`, regenerated, is back to main's list. The changeset drops its `@object-ui/cli` line and names `@object-ui/plugin-detail` instead. The ratchet's pin was not raised, and no type was added to the authoring face.
- `72de91f6` merges `origin/main` (K was 16; clean). The write census and the slot cell re-ran green on it (`Tests 58 passed (58)`).
- `e428aacf` (L1-a R2): a supplied master-detail FK that is not a scalar id (an object such as `{ id }`, or an array) no longer reads as "no master". It marks the write unresolved, which is refused while any record of that master object is held by a locking approval, on insert and on the new end of a reparent. The unresolved refusal now carries the same end-user sentence naming the master as the resolved one. New cell in `detail-row-lock.integration.test.ts`: an insert with `{ id: <locked master> }` is refused and nothing lands (`Tests 11 passed (11)`). Ablation (the insert branch's unscalar check removed): `Tests 1 failed | 10 passed`. Restored, then the whole `plugin-approvals` suite: `Test Files 125 passed (125)`, `Tests 1784 passed (1784)`; `typecheck` exit 0.

<details><summary>Readings on 59d1dbd8 (verify lock, --maxWorkers=1)</summary>

- `registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859`, `exclusion-reason-truthfulness`, `check-side-effects-array`, `known-schema-types-derivation-5115`: `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 101 passed (101)`.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-related-list.*` (8 existing files plus the new `editorSlot-35599`): `Test Files 9 passed (9)`, `Tests 59 passed (59)`.
- `RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx` and `recordEditState.helpers-35599.test.ts`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 75 passed (75)`.
- `RecordBodyTableEditor.recordEditBatch-35599.test.ts` and `affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 60 passed (60)`.
- `type-check` exit 0 for `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/app-shell`. `plugin-detail` was rebuilt first, and its `dist/index.d.ts` names the new context.
- Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `slot.ids.has(` was replaced by `slot.ids.size < 0 && (` (anchor 1 to 0). Result: `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`. The slot cell turned red and both CONTROLs stayed green. Restored: blob == HEAD (`b8aa9e5da87d`), `git diff HEAD` empty. The first attempt used a replacement that still contained the anchor; the tool refused it before running anything, so that attempt was a no-op.
- Local gates, exit 0: `check:nul-bytes`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:platform-checklist` and its `--changed-from origin/main` form, `check-empty-changeset.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check:issue-citations`. This is a declared narrowing to the families that read the files this fix changes. CI runs the rest.

</details>

## Browser reading (A4)

NOT MEASURED. A container restart killed the first run while it was building the dogfood server and console. The resumed run was limited to the affected test files, so no headless Chromium reading was taken and no screenshots exist. The record page's edit state, the discard dialog and the locked-rows gate are pinned only by the harness cells above.

## Verification

Read these files first, ordered by risk:
1. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/lifecycle-hooks.ts`, `bindDetailRowLockHook`. Check the fail-closed branch (no row resolvable) and the per-master exemption filter.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordEditState.tsx`, `RecordEditStateController.save`. Check how op 0 is dropped when the draft is empty, the update-vs-batch choice, and the refusal fan-out.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` and `recordEditState.tsx`'s `requestEnter`. Check the header IIFE hunk (Cancel / Save, and Edit's `disableDuringInlineEdit`), the render-time `setRecordEditEligible`, and how `enterNow` ends an open inline session without reading that as leaving the edit state.

Two-minute check: from `ui/`, run `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx -t recordEditState-35599`. Expect `Tests 7 passed`.

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 121 families on the final tree.
- All run locally, mostly on `d0bdc9da`. The 13 families the `package.json` edit added were run on `9cb0d100`.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `121 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 121 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- Non-zero exits:
  - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` exit 1 on `d0bdc9da`. Four failures came from this diff: the editor registration was outside the `sideEffects` chain, and `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` was stale. Both are fixed in `9cb0d100`, and the two files re-ran green there (above).
  - `pnpm check:query-options-erasure` and `pnpm check:system-context-census` were red on the previous run's tree, from this diff's server half. Both were fixed, and both are green on the final run.
  - NOT MEASURED, prerequisite missing in this box (CI builds it): `check:dts-closure` (exit 1, no `dist` for unbuilt packages such as `plugins/organizations`), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3), and `@objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` (exit 3, `client-react` not built).
  - NOT MEASURED: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (exit 3). This checkout is shallow, and the gate's fixture commit is out of reach.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0 on `9cb0d100`. The byte comparison against a regenerated manifest is CI's (Build & E2E UI).
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: `OK — … 4 anchor(s) judged, 0 lost`.
- `check:nul-bytes` exit 0.
- CI runs the full battery. Its check-runs are not cited here, because they had not concluded when this was written.

</details>
